notes.title: Final Fixes On Math Category
notes.notes: After a good playtesting session everything in the math category seems super polished and to the point. Thank you everyone for the feedback.

notes.title: Fixed Some Extra Math Levels
notes.notes: Some levels in the math category needed polishing and some fixed. Everything works perfectly now :)

notes.title: Fixed Math Levels 111
notes.notes: There was an error with that level. Now everything is fixed :)

notes.title: 27 Sept Update - Navigation Buttons In Levels
notes.notes:
After a very wholesome stream yesterday I got the request that navigation button inside the levels could be a great feature and what else I could do other than fixing it instantly.

Now you can navigate through the levels and you can easily check a previous level if you want to check your solution or explain it to someone fast.

Thank you again everyone for your feedback. This is why the game is getting better every time <3

notes.title: Added Particles
notes.notes:
A small update:

I just added some particles to make the main scene of the game more cozy. And make it load a little slower :)

notes.title: Multiple Solutions On Levels
notes.notes:
After many requests, reviews and finally a really wholesome review from CompassUniverse I added a feature that I was afraid to add because I am a noob programmer sometimes :)

Finally main story (+DLC soon) levels can have multiple answers when it's possible. So some common errors like typing MOON and the solution was THE MOON now works both ways.

Thank you everyone for your feedback. The 2-3 minutes that you take to write down your experience and what you think will make the game better is something that it means the world to me.

notes.title: Fixed Some Transitions
notes.notes: Forgot to add transitions in some scenes. Everything works as planned now. Or hopefully it does :D

notes.title: Big August Update
notes.notes:
Hello friends of Monkid ːsteamhappyː

I worked on some things in August and here is the update with all of them included.

1. [b]Added music in levels[/b]

2. [b]Added transition between scenes[/b]

3. [b]Added the ability to zoom and rotate images on main story[/b]

After getting feedback from players the most important thing was to have the ability to zoom on some images. Also levels now have music so if you don't like it you can just mute it on the spot.

Keep your eyes open because the first DLC will be available in 1st of October and it will be absolutely FREE.

More info about this soon :)

notes.title: Fixed main story levels + Added tutorial
notes.notes:

Fixed some things on the main story of the game to make it easier and don't confuse people.
Also added a tutorial for first time users so they don't lose any of the game choices you can make.

notes.title: Riddle Tower Is Out Now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone 😊

Release time finally arrived. Thank you everyone for the support and most important for the feedback you gave me. From the game to the puzzles to the trailer and everything.

I will do my best to continue to support and make the game as polished as possible and the first DLC is a work in progress so keep your eyes open for it.

Again thank you for everything and I hope you enjoy the game.
Best,
Georgios Tavoularis
